content:
Registry evidence and translations must describe the current legal identity. A related company has its own registry code and cannot supply equivalent evidence merely because its trading name is similar.

The account used for a platform review must match the store entity and required collection currency. A certificate can be authentic while still describing the wrong account or an obsolete bank profile.

New certificates receive new identifiers; existing certificate contents are retained.
